events.result:
Batch 3 migrated, 40 records (120 migrated so far).
Validation note: the old CRM stored phone numbers without country codes. The new CRM
assumed every number was domestic and saved it with a +1 prefix. 31 of the 120
records migrated so far belong to overseas customers, so their phone numbers in the
new CRM are wrong. Records from batches 4 to 10 will have the same problem.
New CRM activity: 14 sales users have opened customer records in the last 24 hours.

args.body: Migration paused after 120 of 400 records: 31 overseas customers have incorrect +1 phone prefixes because the new CRM assumed all numbers were domestic. The remaining 280 records would encounter the same issue. Fourteen sales users opened customer records in the last 24 hours; it is not known whether they viewed affected records. Please advise how to obtain verified country codes and correct the affected records before migration resumes. I recommend warning sales users not to rely on overseas phone numbers in the meantime.
